name: Demo H: Delete-Like Redline Text Note
description: Exercise a delete-like redline operation using a disposable text note target: create a bounded target, prove it is visible, dry-run delete, apply delete, and verify it is absent afterward.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view or sheet that supports text notes.
Keep the generated target text unique per run so repeated live runs cannot match stale notes.
success_criteria: A disposable text note id is created in the requested view.
The created id is visible in the pre-delete visible-element inventory.
The /revit/delete dry-run returns effect evidence covering the created id.
The applied /revit/delete response returns effect evidence covering the created id.
The post-delete visible-element inventory no longer contains the created id.
A deterministic delete visual gate artifact passes using before/after capture evidence.
failure_criteria: The text note target is not created or is created in the wrong view.
The delete dry-run only echoes requested ids and does not return effect evidence.
The applied delete response omits the target id from effect evidence.
The target is still visible after delete.
The delete visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
grader_notes: This task intentionally uses a disposable created target so repeated live runs prove delete mechanics without damaging project content.
Do not count requestedIds-only delete responses as evidence; dry-run and apply must return ids, deletedIds, or impactedIds.
